name: Get out of Death Free:
commands_as_printed: /wear "Fengrot's Eyeball" (or any other ranged HF item you have)
/itemuse "Great Roseberries" (if you have a druid that gives them to you)
source_paragraphs: one of my personal favorites, and very useful not only for yourself but for healing others, although the dodge wont affect anything if you are healing someone else. (note - the spell names will vary depending upon your level)

/combatformset "immortal jade dragon"
/cast "purity"
/wear "Fengrot's Eyeball" (or any other ranged HF item you have)
/itemuse "Great Roseberries" (if you have a druid that gives them to you)
/cast "Lao'Jin Flash"
/cast "Kiss of Heaven V"
/cast "Dodge IV"
Change Lao'Jin Flash, Kiss of Heaven and Dodge to whatever versions you have.

name: Ra'Jin Flare
source_paragraphs: This is a minor one, but very useful if you keep a healing focus item equiped for your heals. basically equips your shurikens, casts Ra'Jin Flare(which turns off Autoattack) and then turns your autoattack back on.

/wear "name of your Shurikens"
/cast "Ra'Jin Flare III"
/autoattack on

name: Heal Spells
source_paragraphs: Another kind of minor one, but if you have a Heal Focus item for your ranged slot, it basically equips it before casting your heal (if you had shurikens equiped already)

/wear "name of your Ranged Focus item"
/cast "Purity"
/cast "heal name"

name: Crit Blessed Whirl / Wind
commands_as_printed: /cast "Blessed Whirl" (insert whichever level of blessed wind you have)
source_paragraphs: Another kind of minor one but, if you crit on your blessed wind chain it will increase the amount it heals for so on my hotkey I have:

/cast "Clarity"
/cast "Blessed Whirl" (insert whichever level of blessed wind you have)
this forces a crit for the heal /HoT and also ensures you have a crit to open up any chains you might need.
